title: Mouri Motonari: Chikai no Sanshi
overview:
The wise general Motonari and his clan. A bond that resounds through the western provinces.

You become Mori Motonari, and then his grandson Terumoto who inherited his will, and aiming to become the ruler of a chaotic age, take on various battles such as the Battle of Itsukushima and the Battle of Kizugawaguchi. A star voice cast, beautiful animation, abundant events... Fully enjoy a battle picture scroll told in a splendid and dynamic way.

Powered up by making use of features unique to the Sega Saturn!
- The fierce fights of the Mori army, such as the "Battle of Itsukushima", are recreated along with events, and of course anecdotes such as the "Lesson of the Three Arrows" appear throughout.
- Your actions at a variety of castle-town facilities such as the "Workshop", "Training Ground" and "Tavern" affect your later fate.
- Battles unfold in various situations such as naval battles, castle sieges and pursuits, with 32 types of units including spearmen, cavalry and martial artists.
- A total of 250 characters.
- Popular voice actors such as Hideyuki Tanaka for a strong sense of presence.
- The opening is a beautiful animated movie.
- 13 original BGM tracks.

智将・元就とその一族。西国に轟く、その絆。

あなたは、毛利元就、そして彼の遺志を継いだ孫・輝元となり、乱世の覇者をめざして、厳島合戦や木津川口の戦いなど様々な戦いに挑みます。豪華声優陣の起用、美しいアニメーション、豊富なイベント……華麗かつダイナミックに綴られる合戦絵巻を存分にご堪能ください。

セガサターンならではの機能を活かしてパワーアップ！
●「厳島合戦」等、毛利軍の激闘をイベントとともに再現、もちろん「三矢の訓え」などの逸話も随所に。
●「工房」「演習場」「酒場」など多彩な城下町施設での行動がその後の運命を左右。
●海戦、城攻め、追撃戦など様々な状況で展開する合戦には、槍兵、騎兵、武芸者をはじめ32種類の部隊が登場。
●総勢250人もの登場人物。
●田中秀幸ら人気声優を起用、臨場感も満点。
●オープニングは美麗なアニメーションムービー。
●オリジナルBGM全13曲
